# Let's verify standard atomic weights and calculate exact MWs using RDKit
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors

# Eugenin
# C11H10O4: 5-hydroxy-7-methoxy-2-methylchromen-4-one
m1 = Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC1=CC(=O)C2=C(O1)C=C(C=C2O)OC")
mw1 = Descriptors.MolWt(m1) if m1 else None

# Lysinoalanine
# C9H19N3O4: (2S)-2-amino-6-[(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)amino]hexanoic acid
m2 = Chem.MolFromSmiles("NCCCC[C@H](N)C(=O)O") # wait, lysinoalanine is N(CC(N)C(=O)O)CCCC(N)C(=O)O
m2_full = Chem.MolFromSmiles("C(CCNCC(C(=O)O)N)C[C@@H](C(=O)O)N")
mw2 = Descriptors.MolWt(m2_full) if m2_full else None

print(f"Eugenin MW: {mw1:.2f} Da (formula {Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m1)})")
print(f"Lysinoalanine MW: {mw2:.2f} Da (formula {Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m2_full)})")
